text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling positions after steep losses taught me to define an evidence-based exit rule before prices fall, rather than letting regret or discomfort dictate the timing.","Buying more Stock A and Stock C while the account was declining showed me to require a clear investment thesis and reassess downside risk before adding to a position.","Frequent account checks and trades can encourage reactive decisions; I will use scheduled reviews and compare each trade with a written plan before acting."]}
